description: This file contains functions related to verifying and performing upgrades using the RedBoot FIS (Flash Image System). It includes functions to check the image format and to upgrade the system, handling different partition schemes and backup options.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image has the correct magic word for RedBoot FIS images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs system upgrade procedures for RedBoot FIS images, handling partition writing and recovery options.
